categorisation: The gazette content consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. This involves the application and execution of an existing law (a regulatory framework) to specific cases, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a government minister (Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando) is named, the core purpose is not about his appointment or his portfolio responsibilities, but about issuing a legal/regulatory order. Therefore, the specialized Type 5 classification takes precedence over a government personnel classification.
